risk_if_not_implemented: Without Developer Threat Analysis & Flaw Remediation, the organization's understanding of the threat environment may become stale, leaving defenses misaligned with active adversary tactics. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_1.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Developer Threat Analysis & Flaw Remediation (TDA-20.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop applications based on Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP).
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP) (TDA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Developer Threat Analysis & Flaw Remediation (TDA-20.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
